brand_notes: PS Audio Aspen line: FR30/FR20/FR10 floorstanders and FR5 standmount (only 2-way), shared 2.5in planar-magnetic tweeter, sold direct with 30-day trial, 3-yr warranty, made in China (stereophile-ps-audio-aspen-fr5). Low sensitivity across the line is a design trait.
takeaways: Planar-magnetic tweeter 2-way with rear passive radiator; $3,499/pair direct.
Klippel LW ±2.7 dB, f3 51 Hz, f6 36 Hz; sensitivity only 81.3 dB (claimed 83.5).
Impedance magnitude easy (min 5.9 Ω) but EPDR to 2.5-2.6 Ω; needs a capable amp.
Vertical crossover suck-out off axis (Stereophile): tweeter at ear height.
Critics unanimous on strong bass for size; subwoofer advised for loud listening.
conflicts: Sensitivity claimed 83.5 vs 81.3 computed / 82.6 Stereophile / 81.7 HFN
Erin review text unreachable; EAC values computed only
